contract.features: exact stage-e raw inputs, price scale and volume context
contract.training_loss: mean over origins and H1..20 of squared cumulative-change error divided by initial-training target second moment, plus original standardized-column ridge
contract.training_second_moment_floor: original train price RMS squared times 1e-6
contract.validation_loss: original mean over H1/5/20 with original initial-training variance
contract.refit: fresh original initialization; mature pretest origins; exactly chosen updates
contract.input_information: history only at all prediction origins; future path used only as matured training labels
contract.independent_sample_count: unchanged; 17 extra dependent supervision coordinates per origin

runtime.precision: float64 for all new response calculations; frozen legacy model float32

datasets.price_definition: Official TJEA daily total published two-decimal transaction mean, CNY/tonne; not closing price
datasets.source_processing: All 1077 official canonical daily-total records retained. Published prices preserved exactly; no row deletion, time filling, turnover-based price recomputation or splice.
datasets.source_vintage: Current public historical snapshot; per-day publication vintages unverified. Evaluation tail scored in stages d and e and is fully exposed development.
datasets.license: No redistribution license established; canonical rows and per-origin arrays remain private

datasets.price_definition: Published CEA daily TOTAL transaction mean in yuan per tonne; not closing price or listing-only mean
datasets.source_processing: All 1251 rows from the official main CEA table retained; date sort and numeric thousands separator removal only. No row deletion, deduplication, time filling, price recomputation or splice.
datasets.source_vintage: Current public historical snapshot; daily publication vintages unverified. Original stage-e and max320 sensitivity scores now fully exposed; stage f is development.
datasets.license: No explicit redistribution license identified; raw rows and per-origin arrays remain private. Public reconstruction code and provenance remain available.
